name: element.find
description: Locate a UI element by accessibility role / name / automation id, optionally rooted at a window. Returns the matched element's accessible properties and bounds. Read-only.

root.description: Optional window handle to scope the search. If omitted, searches the desktop root.

name.description: Accessible name to match (UIA Name / AX kAXTitle). Case-insensitive substring.

automation_id.description: Stable automation identifier (UIA AutomationId, AX kAXIdentifier). Preferred over `name` when available — survives localization.

timeout_ms.description: Time to keep retrying before returning ERR not_found. Default 2000 ms; pass 0 to disable retry (immediate find).

name.description: UIA Name property of the matched element.

automation_id.description: UIA AutomationId of the matched element. Empty string when the element doesn't expose one.

flags.description: Universally-determinable UIA boolean states currently true on the element. Per issue #92. Absent flags are false; only "true" flags are listed.

x-implementations.name: uia_find_first
x-implementations.description: UIA `IUIAutomationElement::FindFirst` with `TreeScope_Subtree` from the supplied root (or RootElement). Builds an `IUIAutomationCondition` from role + (automation_id OR name). Wraps the find in a 250 ms-interval poll loop bounded by `timeout_ms`.

windows-modern.description: IUIAutomation::FindFirst with TreeScope_Subtree from the supplied root or RootElement. Built-in retry loop polls every 250 ms until a match appears or `timeout_ms` expires. ERR uia_blind when the target lives across an integrity-level boundary the agent cannot cross. Reports `flags` per #92.

windows-classic.reason: UIA does not exist pre-Vista. system.info.capabilities.ui_automation: no. The compiler/generator excludes this verb from windows-classic dist/<family>/VERBS.md output.
